## My Hobbies

In my free time, I enjoy engaging in activities that help me relax and maintain a healthy balance between my studies and personal life.

One of my hobbies is playing video games, which helps me unwind and improves my problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. I also enjoy watching movies and television shows as a way to relax and explore different stories and perspectives.

In addition, I enjoy travelling and exploring new places whenever I have the opportunity. Travelling allows me to experience different cultures, environments, and ways of life, which helps broaden my perspective beyond academics.

These hobbies help me manage stress, stay motivated, and maintain a healthy lifestyle during my academic journey.
